MARINE ADVISORY COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, MARCH 12, 2026
  6201 APPIAN WAY
  LONG BEACH YACHT CLUB SKIPPERS COVE, 2:30 PM

Jo Murray, Chair  Elizabeth Carlin, Commissioner
Bruce Mac Rae, Vice Chair  Gordana Kajer, Commissioner
Robert Blair, Commissioner  Elizabeth Lambe, Commissioner
  Theresa Marino, Commissioner

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO EMAIL WRITTEN COMMENTS TO
  TAMALYN.SAYRE@LONGBEACH.GOV

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-54414  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Marine Advisory Commission
  meeting of Thursday, February 12, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-54469  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from Public Works on the Long
  Beach E-scooter pilot program.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-54470  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from the City Manager’s office
  on LA28 Olympics.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-54471  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from the City Manager’s office
  on Homeless Strategy and Partnerships.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  26-54474  Recommendation to endorse submission to approve fee waivers for the following
  regattas:

  • Seal Beach Yacht Club - $5,000.00
  • Long Beach Yacht Club - $5,000.00
  • Navy Yacht Club - $3,500.00

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  26-54476  Recommendation to receive and file the Manager's monthly oral updates.

  Page 1 of 2
   MARINE ADVISORY COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, MARCH 12, 2026
  6201 APPIAN WAY
  LONG BEACH YACHT CLUB SKIPPERS COVE, 2:30 PM

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  26-54477  Recommendation to receive and file the Executive and Tidelands Capital Projects
  Committee status reports.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Marine Advisory Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is
limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Tamalyn Sayre, Bureau Secretary, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior
to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact the Marine Bureau at (562) 570-3215 by noon the
day prior to the meeting.
